missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Судья' is an animate masculine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'вошёл'. 'В зал суда' marks the destination of motion.
Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Судью' is the accusative direct object of 'слушали'. For this animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive form.
Strategic focus: Genitive of belonging. 'Судьи' is the genitive form marking whose decision it was. 'Было' agrees with the neuter subject 'решение', and 'справедливым' is the instrumental predicate.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Судье' is dative after 'к', marking the judge as the goal of motion. A natural courtroom phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Судьёй' is instrumental after 'с', marking the person spoken with. 'Спокойно' describes the manner of the conversation.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Судье' is the prepositional form after 'в', here figuratively locating experience within the person. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.

missions.phrase: Новый судья очень строгий и честный.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Судья' is the nominative subject. 'Новый', 'строгий', and 'честный' are agreeing masculine adjectives describing him.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Судьи' is the nominative plural subject of 'вынесли'. 'Окончательное' agrees with the neuter object 'решение'.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural of an animate noun. 'Судей' is the accusative plural object of 'ждали'; for animate nouns the accusative plural equals the genitive plural. 'У входа' marks the place.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural of belonging. 'Судей' is the genitive plural marking whose opinions. 'Мнения' is the nominative plural subject, and 'различались' agrees with it.
